evals.input: I'm about to launch a creator campaign with 5 TikTok creators for a DTC skincare brand. How do I set up tracking?
expect: Provides UTM link structure with utm_source, utm_medium, utm_campaign, utm_content
Recommends unique promo codes per creator as the primary conversion signal
Explains how to shorten UTM links for TikTok bio use
Mentions requesting creator's TikTok Insights screenshots
Sets up the tracking before content goes live

evals.input: My campaign just ended. Here's the data: Creator A spent $400, drove 120k views and 38 promo code uses worth $1,140. Creator B spent $600, drove 85k views and 12 uses worth $360. Write the report.
expect: Calculates ROAS for each creator (Creator A: 2.9x, Creator B: 0.6x)
Compares engagement rates against platform benchmarks
Identifies Creator A as top performer, Creator B as underperformer
Produces a structured wrap report with per-creator breakdown table
Includes a recommendation on who to renew and what to test next
